'''Solar Essence''' is a [[Monster Loot]] item which is dropped from the [[Ghost]], [[Bats|Iridium Bat]], [[Metal Head]], [[Metal Head (dangerous)]], [[Haunted Skull]], [[Squid Kid]], [[Squid Kid (dangerous)]], [[Mummy]], [[Hot Head]], and [[Blue Squid]]. [[Krobus]] also sells 10 a day for {{Price|80}} each. [[Sunfish]] may randomly produce a Solar Essence in a [[Fish Pond]] when the pond population reaches 10 fish.

==Tailoring==
Solar Essence is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt219.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Yoba Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*A Solar Essence is needed for the 3rd part of [[Quests#The Mysterious Qi|"The Mysterious Qi" Quest]].
*5 Solar Essence may be requested by several fish in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 7 to 10.

==History==
{{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]]. Can be requested in [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quests]]. Can be produced by [[Fish Pond]]s.}}
{{History|1.5|Used as an ingredient to the [[Quality Bobber]], [[Mini-Obelisk]], and [[Hyper Speed-Gro]] recipes. No longer used as an ingredient to the [[Skull Brazier]] recipe.}}
